śeṣāṇām ādau puruṣa-arthatā kāraṇaṃ
bhavati / Sa ca–artho hetur nimitta-kāraṇaṃ
1190 bhavati–ity anityā–ākhyāyate / Guṇās tu
sarva-dharma-anupātino na pratyastam ayante na–upajāyante / Vyaktibhir eva–atīta-
anāgata-vyaya-āgamavatībhir
guṇa-anvayinībhir
upajanana-apāya-dharmakā
iva
pratyavabhāsante / Yathā devadatto daridrāti / Kasmāt ? / Yato'sya mriyante gāva iti /
Gavām eva maraṇāt tasya daridrāṇaṃ na svarūpa-hānād iti / Samaḥ samādhiḥ / Liṅga-
mātram aliṅgasya pratyāsannaṃ tatra tat saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vivicyate krama-anativṛtteḥ / Tathā ṣaḍ
aviśeṣā liṅga-mātre saṃsṛṣṭā vivicyante pariṇāma-krama-niyamāt / Tathā teṣv aviśeṣu bhūta-
indriyāṇ
